dungeonDesc.text:
The deafening blast brought embers of war from a century ago. Nevertheless, the Civilization Band was not destroyed by the Aggeloid bombardment. 
"It wasn't just the Aggeloi that brought humanity close to extinction. And that is the tragedy."

description.text: The "Kriosson" (archive ID: ACL071) is amongst the earliest recorded form of the Aggeloi and the most commonly encountered. It attacks by ramming its victims with its horns.
The "Varykentron" (archive ID: ARL141) is a non-standard variant of ARL121. It would occasionally perform whip attacks with its tail instead of using its ranged energy attack.
The "Kentron Anavon" (archive ID: ARL121α) is an energized variant of ARL121. The entity's higher energy density gives it greater firepower. The energy efficiency of its firing mechanism remains low.

The "Psuthopteron" (archive ID: ARA07C) has flight capabilities that are wholly unrelated to its morphology. This pattern was originally regarded as biomimicry. However, the modern consensus believes it was a mimic of Terran flying vehicles.

decoDesc.text: A data storage unit developed by Endfield Industries. It is compatible with various data access devices. New operators can use it to effectively acquire combat knowledge. Thanks to support offered by the Cabal of Tranquility, this carrier features data compression technology and thus stores even more information.

desc.text: A material that provides a lot of EXP for leveling up Lv.61-90 operators.

decoDesc.text: A single-use toolset with AIC technology. Provides automated in-depth inspection of the entire weapon structure. Also repairs internal material damage and significantly enhances weapon performance.

desc.text: A material that provides a lot of weapon EXP.

decoDesc.text: A special crystal polyhedron manufactured using Techno-Protocol and advanced crystallization processes. Often combined with other devices to improve physiological absorption of enhancement materials.

desc.text: A material that upgrades operator skills.

decoDesc.text: A popular currency furnished with highly advanced anti-counterfeiting technologies. You know it's good money when you can purchase things with it.

desc.text: TC for short. This currency is recognized and used in many places.

decoDesc.text: The perseverance of life and continuation of civilization have left their marks upon this place.

desc.text: A rare material that upgrades operator skill mastery.

dungeonDesc.text:
The snowy fog never seems to dissipate from these wildlands. Crisp sounds of shattering could be heard hidden within the low rumblings. 
Listen close. Did you hear ... stone grinding against metal?

dungeonDesc.text:
The giant machine wreckage in the distance heralded the great events of the past. Nearby, disassembled entities began to coalesce, creating newborn entities that belched with earth-rending howls. 
The land began to tremble as the Aggeloi slammed into the ground and waded their ponderous steps.

featureDesc.text:
- Operator Stamina regeneration rate is greatly reduced.
 - Enemies are stronger and immune to Stagger.
 - The Walking Chrysopolis recovers from weakpoint exposures more quickly. Failing to destroy a weakpoint before weakpoint exposure ends gives the Walking Chrysopolis a massive ATK buff. Successfully destroying the weakpoint applies Staggered to the Walking Chrysopolis.

  <@ba.info>- Tacticals and consumables cannot be used.</>
